subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw standardize a cross-channel pre-processing text acknowledgment lifecycle, or leave immediate presence feedback to channel-owned reactions, typing, and draft previews?
rationale: Either direction changes public messaging behavior and possibly configuration or plugin contracts; source inspection cannot decide whether extra visible messages and their cleanup semantics are desirable across all channels.

options.title: Standardize one lifecycle
options.body: Add a typed early-progress contract with channel capability handling and integrate fixed text, previews, edits, deletion, and final delivery coherently.

options.title: Keep feedback channel-owned
options.body: Decline a global text acknowledgment and continue improving reactions, typing, and draft previews independently in each channel.

recommendation.title: Standardize one lifecycle
recommendation.body: Add a typed early-progress contract with channel capability handling and integrate fixed text, previews, edits, deletion, and final delivery coherently.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared reply-delivery, typing, and acknowledgment lifecycle has most recently been shaped by this contributor's merged work.
